lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region. The spots are organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows with periodic vertical alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable, intersecting the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a rectilinear pattern of high-intensity nodes, most distinct in the region dorsal to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-luminance shadow immediately below.
